name: gtfs-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4 server for downloading, parsing, and serving GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) data. Transit data access with parser handling malformed feeds.

tools.name: add_feed
tools.description: Add/update a GTFS feed by downloading its zip

tools.name: get_stop_routes
tools.description: List the transit lines serving a stop

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List all transit lines of a feed

tools.name: remove_feed
tools.description: Delete a feed from the depot

tools.name: export_feed
tools.description: Export a depot feed to the publictransport-mcp city app
